mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO agent_message (session_id, run_id, role, content, tool_calls, tool_call_id, tool_code, token_in, token_out, cost, latency_ms, seq) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{runId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{toolCalls}, #{toolCallId}, #{toolCode},
COALESCE(#{tokenIn}, 0), COALESCE(#{tokenOut}, 0), COALESCE(#{cost}, 0), COALESCE(#{latencyMs}, 0), COALESCE(#{seq}, 0))
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.role, m.content, m.create_time FROM agent_message m JOIN agent_session s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE s.memory_id = #{memoryId} ORDER BY m.seq ASC, m.id ASC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1 FROM agent_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
